[SWS_DM_02051] Reporting successful reset of
ECU
to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service ECUReset is received, which results in a positive re-
sponse, the DM shall report a security event SEV_UDS_ECU_RESET_SUCCESSFUL
